mg.title: Share with my students

text.main: I would take off just to learn the lessons of the inmates and share them with my students

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway on her words, after the name super. It can also hide a pause trim.

mg.title: A young man

text.main: There was a young man who stood up

mg.use: Top band over the rows of men listening, as she says it. Never name him.

mg.title: Focus on the room

mg.title: At risk in high school

text.main: I teach at risk in high school

mg.use: Over Audrey as she says it. Never name the school or the district.

mg.title: His message
mg.src: Audrey, Interview_Audrey.MOV [04:52], his words as she says them.
mg.use: The big text for his message, over the hands writing. One line at a time, each on her word.

mg.title: Stay in school

text.main: He impacted so many kids to stay in school

mg.use: Over Audrey as she says it. Orange bar, white text.

mg.title: From his lips

text.main: coming from his lips rather than mine had such an impact on them

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway on the second half of this bite. Keep her voice under it.

mg.title: Not who you are

text.main: You did something. It's an action. It's not who you are.

mg.use: Over her face on the last line, top band. Keep captions on. Hold one second after.
